answer: In our flight control network, each agent identity is bound to a hardware-rooted key woven into a hash trellis of attested boot measurements, so a sybil cannot forge a distinct lineage without a unique pigment of measured state. Colluding nodes that reuse one physical root leave a faint ember of correlated timing jitter, which Byzantine fault containment detects as. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
